To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the integration of management concepts in international public relations education is necessary to prepare future practitioners.
the integration of management practices in public relations courses can be achieved by including a set of contents related to international public relations management.

1) the current approaches to international public relations teaching are based on the assumption that the main objective of international public relations is to promote a global understanding among cultures, 2) these approaches are limited in their ability to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of how to manage public relations campaigns across borders, and 3) an effective international public relations curriculum must integrate the study of international business practices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a proposal for an international public relations course that includes a management perspective.
the need to integrate management practices in international courses of public relations.
the need for a more comprehensive approach in the teaching of international public relationships.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the teaching of international public relationships should be expanded to include the study of business and management practices.
the teaching of international public relation courses should be more comprehensive and should integrate management practices.
a truly effective international PR education should include both the intercultural and the managerial aspects of the discipline.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

international public relations education must integrate the study of management practices in order to prepare students for a professional world that demands the ability to manage and lead in a global context.
international public relations education must include the study of international business practices and their implications for the profession.

international public relations is a complex field that should be approached from a multidisciplinary and integrated perspective, and that the current approaches to its teaching have overlooked the realities and needs of the professional world.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the teaching of international public relation courses should be expanded to incorporate a broader view of the professional world and its management practices.
a comprehensive education in public relations should not only focus on intercultural issues, but also on business management issues.
the current approach to international public relations education in American universities is not sufficient to prepare students for the professional world.
